added_models.model: Human PK/PD model of BTK inhibition fitted to fenebrutinib healthy-volunteer data

engagement.model: Human PK/PD model of BTK inhibition fitted to fenebrutinib healthy-volunteer data
engagement.population: Unselected (moderately to severely active SLE on standard therapy)
engagement.confidence_note: Abstract read (Herman 2018, epub 2018-03-23). The SLE trial (NCT02908100) chose its regimens from this model before its publication.
engagement.judgement: Opening at the model's publication; it was fitted to healthy volunteers, so its first test in the context is SLE patients.
engagement.note: PK/PD simulations on healthy-volunteer data set fenebrutinib regimens expected to keep BTK inhibition high over the dosing interval.
engagement.quote: Based on pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic (PK/PD) simulations, a once-daily dosing regimen (e.g., 100 mg, q.d.) is expected to maintain a high level of BTK inhibition over the dosing interval.

engagement.model: Human PK/PD model of BTK inhibition fitted to fenebrutinib healthy-volunteer data
engagement.population: Unselected (moderately to severely active SLE on standard therapy)
engagement.magnitude_basis: observed pBTK reduction at measured steady-state troughs vs model-predicted pBTK (Supplementary Figure 6)
engagement.confidence_note: Full text read (Wiley HTML); the model-vs-observed pBTK figure is supplementary and not read, so magnitude is direction only. Registry results posted 2020-07-07; the comparison itself is in the paper.
engagement.quote: These concentrations were associated with reductions in pBTK levels consistent with those predicted based on pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic modeling using healthy volunteer data
engagement.note: In SLE patients, fenebrutinib troughs lowered pBTK as the healthy-volunteer PK/PD model predicted; sustained to week 48.
engagement.judgement: pBTK (BTK autophosphorylation in PBMC lysate) taken as a direct readout of target inhibition; the paper states the model-patient agreement itself.

considered_not_added: Evobrutinib healthy-volunteer occupancy (Becker 2019, doi 10.1111/cts.12713): same system as the draft's mouse-btk-occupancy-pkpd occupancy target; status-neutral, belongs on that track
Elsubrutinib (ABBV-105) occupancy-efficacy correlation in IFNa-accelerated NZB/W mice (Goess 2019): same systems as draft's nzbw-lupus-mouse / occupancy tracks
Elsubrutinib SLEek biomarker paper (Lupus Sci Med 2026): abstract unavailable; same nzbw-lupus-mouse track per checker
SLE patient ex vivo B cells / patient-derived cells: no member-drug study comparing ex vivo response with patient outcome found
X-linked agammaglobulinemia (human BTK loss of function): cited as rationale only; no source compares it with member-drug SLE results
Rat collagen-induced arthritis / RA trials as cross-indication model (fenebrutinib, evobrutinib, elsubrutinib): no source uses them to predict SLE outcome
Ibrutinib-treated lupus mice and BTK-knockout B cells (Shi 2025): ibrutinib is not a class member and no patient comparison
Fenebrutinib RA population PK / model-based meta-analysis (Pharm Res 2020): RA, not SLE; no SLE comparison
Member GLP toxicology: already tracked (member-gltox), unpublished

gaps.detail: Checker itself found no new track: same nzbw-lupus-mouse system and status-neutral (no change of status: one entry per change); abstract unavailable, so no verifiable quote to add.
